The '''Adrenal Processing Factory''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] facility located on [[Quesh]] that processed [[Venenit queshaaga]] into combat adrenals. During the [[Quesh war]] the factory was attacked by the forces of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Adrenal Processing Factory appears as an area on Quesh in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
